params.body:
## Why

Every new dealer and merchant got a seed row of three stars on creation (`DealerController::store`, `MerchantController::store`), so a party nobody had ever rated showed 3/5 on the stocklist card, the seller block and the biddings page, which reads as "mediocre". Open point O-12.

Ilse decided on 17 September 2026 ("we volgen hier je voorstel om te starten zonder en na reviews het aantal tonen en berekenen"): no reviews is "--" (nog geen beoordelingen) with no star filled; with reviews, the average with one decimal and the count, "4,3/5 (12 beoordelingen)", "4/5 (3 beoordelingen)", the stars drawn to the nearest half. Recorded as `klant:beslissingen#sterren-zonder-beoordeling`.

## What changed

- `App\Support\Rating`: the one place that turns review rows into count, average, stars (nearest half) and text (one decimal, dropped when whole; a comma except in English).
- `x-ui.rating` (`resources/views/components/ui/rating.blade.php`): draws it, with the full sentence as `title`/`aria-label`; `compact` for the card ("4,3/5 (12)"). Tailwind classes only, no new `ui-` class, so `refresh.css` is untouched.
- Used on the stocklist card (`_grid_card`), the seller block on the detail (`buybox`, which had its own star formula), the bidders on the biddings page (`biddingDetails`) and the legacy `index_card`. The three copies of the star arithmetic are gone.
- No seed rows any more in `DealerController::store` and `MerchantController::store`. `Dealer::seller_reviews`, `Dealer::buyer_reviews` and `Merchant::buyer_reviews` leave out rows without a `vehicle_id`: a review rates a transaction and always carries its vehicle (all four store paths in `Voting` set it), the seed rows never did. So existing dealers with only the old seed show "--" as well, without a data migration.
- Lang keys `vote.no_reviews_yet`, `vote.reviews` (choice), `vote.summary` in nl, fr, en, de.
- Docs: decision in `bronnen/beslissingen.md`; O-12 `opgelost`; rule rows R S5-1.14, R S5-3.3, R B1-5.2 and R B1-5.9 updated (B1-5.9 said a new merchant starts with three stars, now the opposite, with both sources kept).

## Tests

`tests/Feature/RatingDisplayTest.php` (7 tests): 0 votes gives "--", no star filled, "Nog geen beoordelingen"; 12 votes averaging 4.3 give "4,3/5 (12 beoordelingen)" and 4.5 stars (4 full, 1 half); whole averages drop the decimal, one review is singular; the component in both modes; the stocklist card for a seller with only the old seed row ("--", count 0) and for a rated seller ("4,3/5 (12)", 4.5 stars).

Run green locally: RatingDisplayTest, RatingScreenTest, BiddingFunnelTest, StocklistBrowser*, StocklistDetail*, KlantmodusTest, RulesCoverageTest, RulesIdentityTest, RulesSourcesTest, LanguageParityTest, StylesheetSyntaxTest, AlpineExpressionTest, HandlerWiringTest, CompiledViewsTest, ExportListPhoneCardTest, SmokeTest (the three `ownvehicle.edit` failures there are the missing `public/js/vehicle/create.js` build output in a worktree without a build, unrelated).

No hot shared files touched.

## Screenshots

Card with 12 reviews next to a card without (1440 and 390), and the seller block on the detail for both dealers: in the report.
